output.review_comment: The PR correctly fixes input validation and the missing teams issue, but the tie-breaking logic adds an extra `-allocation[team]` tier that deviates from the docstring specification. The docstring clearly states: "When quotients are tied, use larger headcount; if headcounts are also tied, use listed order." The PR's code inserts "fewest desks allocated" as an intermediate tie-breaker not mentioned in the docstring. While this doesn't break the provided tests (they apparently don't exercise the edge case where quotients are equal but teams have different allocations), it contradicts the docstring which was specified as the source of truth. Remove the `-allocation[team]` element from the key tuple to match the docstring specification exactly.
